y-m-07-06.title: 3 kaar oo tirooyin ah: halkee ayuu wax-soo-saarku weynaadaa?
y-m-07-06.topic: Helidda kiisaska leh wax-soo-saar weyn marka la sameynayo tibaaxaha (tiro laba-xaraf ah)×(tiro hal-xaraf ah) adigoo isticmaalaya kaararka tirooyinka
y-m-07-06.goal: Tijaabi fikradda "haddii aad samayso tirada laba-xaraf ah ee ugu weyn, wax-soo-saarkuna sidoo kale waa kan ugu weyn" adigoo naftaada samaynaya tibaaxo, hel dhowr tibaax oo wax-soo-saar weyn leh, oo qor sababta.
y-m-07-06.material: Waxaa jira hal kaar mid kasta oo tirooyinka 3, 5, iyo 7 ah. Isticmaal kaar kasta saxda ah hal mar si aad u samayso tibaax (tiro laba-xaraf ah)×(tiro hal-xaraf ah). Tusaale ahaan, dhig 3 iyo 5 isku xigta si aad u samayso 35 oo ku dhufo 7, taasoo siinaysa 35×7 (soddon iyo shan jeer toddobo). Ha rogin kaararka. Harin wuxuu yidhi, "Haddii aan sameeyo tirada laba-xaraf ah ee ugu weyn, 75, oo ku dhufto 3, wax-soo-saarku wuxuu noqonayaa kan ugu weyn!"
y-m-07-06.thinking.1: Samaynta dhowr tibaax oo buuxiya shuruudaha
y-m-07-06.prereq.1: Sida loo sameeyo tiro laba-xaraf ah adigoo isticmaalaya kaararka tirooyinka (meesha tobanaadka, meesha kelida)
y-m-07-06.s.s1.prompt: Dooro xukunka aad hadda gaari karto ee ku saabsan waxa Harin yidhi.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Samee hal tibaax oo kale marka laga reebo 75×3, naftaada u xisaabi, oo barbar dhig wax-soo-saarrada.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.1: Marka hore tiri imisa tibaax guud ahaan ayaa lagu samayn karaa 3-da kaar.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.a: Waa sax. Marka tirada laba-xaraf ah ay tahay tan ugu weyn, wax-soo-saarku sidoo kale waa kan ugu weyn.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.a: Tirada hal-xaraf ah ee aad ku dhufanayso sidoo kale way is beddelaysaa iyadoo ku xidhan kaararka. Waa inaadan eegin tirada laba-xaraf ah oo keliya.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.b: Weli ma ognin. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan barbar dhigno wax-soo-saarrada habaynta kaararka kale.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay aragtay inaad tijaabiso haddii sheegashadu sax tahay adigoo barbar dhigaya tibaaxo kale. Waa xukun wanaagsan oo isku dayaya inuu ururiyo caddayn.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Ma u muuqato sax. Isku-dhufteha 3 waa yar yahay, sidaas darteed waxay noqon kartaa khasaare.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Tani waxay tilmaantay in isku-dhufteha uu yaraado. Laakiin maadaama ay tahay qiyaas, waa inaad ku hubisaa adigoo barbar dhigaya tibaaxo kale.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.d: Wax-soo-saarku waa isku mid si kasta oo aad u dhigto, sidaas darteed barbar dhig looma baahna.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Intaadan go'aamin wax-soo-saarradu inay isku mid yihiin, naftaada u xisaabi dhowr tibaax. Waxay noqon karaan kuwo aad u kala duwan.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.explain: 75×3=225. Haddii aad xisaabiso tibaaxo kale, waxaa jira wax-soo-saarro ka weyn, sida 35×7=245. Sheegashada Harin ma sax aha, laakiin isku dayidda dhowr tibaax marka hore waa hab fiican oo lagu hubiyo.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.acc.0: Tani waa qiyaas macquul ah. Laakiin maadaama ay tahay qiyaas, waa inaad naftaada u hesho wax-soo-saarrada si aad u hubiso.

y-m-07-05.title: 1/2 iyo 1/4 xadhig: yaa isticmaalay wax badan?
y-m-07-05.topic: Jajabyada waxaa lagu barbar dhigi karaa cabbir marka wadarta ay isku mid tahay oo keliya (jajabyo wadarooyin kala duwan)
y-m-07-05.goal: Fahan in jajabyada wadarooyin kala duwan aan lagu barbar dhigi karin cabbirka jajabyada oo keliya, habee macluumaadkee ayaa awood u siinaya barbar dhigid, oo adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyin hel kiisaska dhererka labada qof isticmaaleen uu isku mid yahay.
y-m-07-05.material: Jian wuxuu isticmaalay 1/2 xadhig casaan ah, Doyun na wuxuu isticmaalay 1/4 xadhig buluug ah. Ma ognin haddii labada xadhig ay bilowga isku dherer yihiin. Xadhig kasta waxay ahayd tiir keliya oo aan la gooyin, 1/2 iyo 1/4 na macnaha waa xadhigga qof kasta oo dhan oo loo kala qaybiyay qaybo siman. 1/2 waxaa loo akhriyaa "hal kala bar" 1/4 na waxaa loo akhriyaa "hal rubuc."

y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.a: Tani waxay tilmaantay in jajab uu ku saabsan yahay "wadarta u gaarka ah." Ka fikir macluumaadkee dheeraad ah ayaa kuu ogolaan lahaa inaad go'aamiso.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.b: Waa Jian, sababtoo ah 1/2 wuu ka weyn yahay 1/4.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.b: 1/2 wuu ka weyn yahay 1/4 marka lagu barbar dhigo isla wadar oo keliya. Marka hore eeg haddii wadarta labada xadhig isku mid tahay.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.c: Waa Doyun, sababtoo ah hooseeyaha 4 wuu ka weyn yahay 2.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.c: Hooseeye weyn ma ka dhigo dhererka la isticmaalay mid dheer. Haddii wadarooyinku kala duwan yihiin, imisa cm way is beddelaysaa.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.d: Waxay u badan tahay Jian. Waa naadir in wadarooyinku kala duwan yihiin.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.d: Sabab lagu yidhaahdo "naadir" ma jirto. Ku tijaabi tirooyin waxa dhaca haddii xadhigyadu leeyihiin wadarooyin kala duwan.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.explain: 1/2 wuu ka weyn yahay 1/4 marka lagu barbar dhigo isla wadar (xadhigyo isku dherer ah). Tusaale ahaan, haddii xadhigga casaanku yahay 20cm, 1/2 waa 10cm, laakiin haddii xadhigga buluugu yahay 80cm, 1/4 waa 20cm, taasoo ka dheer, haddii xadhigga buluugu yahay 8cm na, 1/4 waa 2cm, taasoo ka gaaban. y-m-07-05.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan qaybaha macluumaadka oo ah hal shay oo dheeraad ah oo keliya waxay kuu ogolaan lahayd inaad go'aamiso yaa wax badan isticmaalay. (Mid kasta si gooni ah uga fikir.)
y-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.0: U qaado macluumaadka inuu run yahay, dhig xadhigga casaanka 20cm, samee tusaalayaal dhererka xadhigga buluuga mid mid, oo hel dhererrada labada qof isticmaaleen.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.1: Macluumaad kasta, samee laba ama ka badan tusaale oo kala duwan oo dhererka xadhigga buluuga ah oo hubi haddii gabagabadu had iyo jeer isku mid tahay.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.a: Xadhigga buluugga ah wuu ka dheer yahay xadhigga casaanka ah.

y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.b: Waad ogtahay haddii wadarooyinku isku mid yihiin, waad isla markiiba barbar dhigi kartaa cabbirrada jajabyada.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.c: Labada qof labadooduba waxay isticmaaleen kala bar ama ka yar xadhigooda u gaarka ah.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.c: 1/2 iyo 1/4 horeyba waa kala bar ama ka yar. Waxba cusub ma baran.

y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.d: Haddii xadhigga buluuga uu ka gaaban yahay, 1/4-keeda wuu ka sii gaaban yahay, oo waxaad la barbar dhigi kartaa 1/2 xadhigga casaanka. Tani waxay isticmaashay xiriirka u dhexeeya cabbirrada wadarooyinka.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.e: Xadhigga buluuga wuxuu u dhigan yahay 4 jeer dhererka xadhigga casaanka.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.e: Tani waa macluumaad bixiya xiriirka u dhexeeya cabbirrada wadarooyinka sida jibbaar sax ah. Waad beddeli kartaa 1/4 si ay ugu taal xadhigga casaanka.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.explain: U yeedh xadhigga casaanka R iyo xadhigga buluuga B. Markaas Jian wuxuu isticmaalay kala bar R Doyun na wuxuu isticmaalay 1/4 B. Haddii labada xadhig isku mid yihiin, Jian wuxuu isticmaalaa wax badan. Haddii xadhigga buluuga uu ka gaaban yahay, Jian weli wuxuu isticmaalaa wax badan. Haddii xadhigga buluuga uu 4 jeer ka dheer yahay, Doyun wuxuu isticmaalaa sida R, sidaas darteed Doyun wuxuu isticmaalaa wax badan. Adigoo ogaanaya xadhigga buluuga ka dheer yahay oo keliya, ma ogaan kartid haddii uu ka dheer yahay 2 jeer, sidaas darteed ma go'aamin kartid.

y-m-07-01.topic: Marka aad qiyaasto tirooyin saddex-god ah, maxaad baran kartaa haddii qiyaasku la mid yahay halbeegga?
y-m-07-01.goal: Garo in marka qiyaasku saxda la mid yahay halbeegga (1000 won), way adag tahay in gunaanad laga gaadho qiyaasidda oo keliya. Saxo xukunkaaga iyo intee ayaad hubtaa mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub yimaado, oo samee tusaale halkaas oo xataa marka qiyaasyadu isku mid yihiin, qiimayaasha dhabta ahi ay dhinacyada labada halbeegga ku yaalliin.

Marka la qiyaasayo boqolaadka ugu dhow, kor u wareeji haddii god tobanaadku yahay 5 ama ka badan oo hoos u wareeji haddii uu yahay 4 ama ka yar. Tusaale ahaan, 460 waxaa loo qiyaasaa 500 iyo 440 400.

y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Qiyaasku waa 1000, sidaa darteed wuxuu ka dhaafayaa 1000 won oo ma iibsan karo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Qiyaasta 1000 waxay la simanyahay lacagta aan haysto, 1000 won. Si loo yiraahdo "wuu dhaafayaa," waa inuu ka weyn yahay 1000.

y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Fikirkani wuxuu tixgeliyey in marka qiyaasku la mid yahay halbeegga, qiimaha dhabta ahi uu ka weyn ama ka yar yahay halbeegga.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ma yaqaan qiimaha saxda ah, sidaa darteed waxba ma odhan karo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Qiyaasi sidoo kale waa macluumaad faa'iido leh. Waad ogtahay in qiime kasta uu u dhow yahay 500 won. Ka shaqee intee aad ku tagi karto macluumaadkaas.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Marka uu u soo dhowaaday oo uu eegay, cuntada fudud waxay ahayd 487 won cabitaankuna wuxuu ahaa 518 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda, sidee u malaynaysaa wadarta labada qiime inay la barbar dhigmaan 1000 won?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.after: 487 waa 13 ka yar 500 518 na waa 18 ka badan 500, sidaa darteed wadartu waa 5 ka badan 1000. Marka si sax ah la isku daro, 487+518=1005. Xukunkii bilowga ee ahaa "way adag tahay in la go'aamiyo" weli sax ayuu ahaa, hadda na sabab ayaa jirta.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Xad-dhaafka 18 wuu ka badan yahay yaraanta 13, sidaa darteed wadartu waa ka badan tahay 1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tani waxay heshay in 518 uu 18 ka badan yahay 500 iyo 487 uu 13 ka yar yahay 500, oo isbarbar dhigtay xaddiga xad-dhaafka iyo xaddiga ka yar. Waa hab fiican oo mar kale loogu eego qiimayaasha la qiyaasay tirooyin.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 487 waa ka yar yahay 500, sidaa darteed wadartu sidoo kale waa ka yar tahay 1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Tani waxay ka tagtay in 518 uu ka weyn yahay 500. Waa inaad wada eegtaa intee ayuu qiime kasta ka duwan yahay 500.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Labaduba waa ku dhawaad 500, sidaa darteed wadartu waa saxda 1000 won sida ay tahay.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: "Ku dhawaad" macnaheedu maaha isku mid. Hel farqiga u dhexeeya tirada calaamadda qiime kasta iyo 500.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Qiyaasidda oo keliya ma i sheegayso, sidaa darteed waxaan si sax ah ugu dari doonaa 487+518 si aan u go'aamiyo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Xukunkani wuxuu u malaynayaa qiyaasku inuusan ku filnayn oo wuxuu isku dayaa inuu ku hubiyo xisaab sax ah. Waa hab-dhaqan fiican in qiyaasidda iyo xisaabinta la wada isticmaalo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Hajun wuxuu ka helay 2 qodob oo kale oo 10 won ah boorsadiisa gudaheeda. Hadda lacagta uu haysto waa 1020 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Maxuu odhan karaa marka uu xukumo isagoo ku darayo xaqiiqda cusub?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 1005 won waa ka yar yahay 1020 won, sidaas darteed wuu iibsan karaa oo 15 won ayaa harsan. Xitaa isla qiimayaasha, marka lacagta aad haysato isbeddesho, gabagabadu way isbeddeshaa. Go'aaminta qiyaasta 1000 oo keliya markan waa sax ahayd, laakiin sababeyntiisu waxay ahayd mid daciif ah.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Wadarta waa 1005 won, taasoo ka badan 1000 won, sidaas darteed weli ma iibsan karo.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tani ma gelin lacagihii cusbaa ee la helay lacagta uu haysto. Marka hore hubi haddii lacagta uu haysto ay isbeddeshay.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Wadarta 1005 won waa ka yar tahay lacagta uu haysto, 1020 won, sidaas darteed wuu iibsan karaa.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tani si toos ah ayay u barbar dhigtay lacagta uu haysto ee isbeddeshay iyo wadarta dhabta ah. Si fiican ayay u muujisay in macluumaad cusub uu beddelo shuruudda.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Qiyaasta 1000 waa ka yar tahay 1020, sidaas darteed wuu iibsan karaa isagoo eegaya qiyaasta oo keliya.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Gabagabadu waa isku mid, laakiin xusuuso sida qiyaasta iyo wadarta dhabta ahi u kala duwanaadeen. Barbar dhigga qiyaasyada midba midka kale way adag tahay in lagu kalsoonaado marka farqigu yar yahay.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 1005 iyo 1020 way isku egyihiin, sidaas darteed ma ogaan karno kee ka weyn.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 1005 iyo 1020 isla markiiba waa la barbar dhigi karaa. Barbar dhig cabbirka tirooyinka si aad u aragto kee ka weyn.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.reflect: Bayaanka ah qiyaastii bilowga ahaa 1000, maxaad ka ogaan kartay iyo maxaadan ogaan karin? Kadib aragtida tirooyinka saxda ah ee xaashida qiimaha, iyo kadib helidda lacago dheeraad ah, sidee fikirkaaga ama sida aad u hubto u isbeddeshay? Haddii aad sii haysatay fikirkaagii koowaad sida uu ahaa, sheeg sababta sidoo kale.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.prompt: Samee laba lammaane oo qiimayaal ah oo wadarta qiyaasyadu tahay 1000 won laakiin wadarta dhabta ahi aysan ahayn 1000 won. Hal lammaane waa inuu leeyahay wadar ka weyn 1000 won, lammaanaha kalena waa inuu leeyahay wadar ka yar 1000 won. Cuntada yar a won iyo cabitaanka b won mid kastaa waa tiro dabiici ah oo 100 won ilaa 999 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka bilow samaynta lammaanaha leh wadar ka weyn 1000. Ka dhig hal qiime wax yar ka sarreeya 500 qiimaha kalena wax yar ka hooseeya 500.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.1: Marka aad samayso hal lammaane, is-beddel qadarka sare iyo qadarka hoose si aad u samayso lammaane wadartiisu ka yar tahay 1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Labada qiime waa tirooyin dabiici ah oo 100 won ilaa 999 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Labada qiime waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dabiici ah oo 100 ilaa 999.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Qiyaasidda mid kasta boqolaadka ugu dhow oo la isku daro waxay siinaysaa 1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Qiyaasidda qiime kasta boqolaadka ugu dhow oo la isku daro ma siinayso 1000. Hubi xeerka ah haddii god-lambarka tobanaadku yahay 5 ama ka badan kor u wareeji.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Wadarta dhabta ahi ma aha 1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Haddii wadarta dhabta ahi tahay si sax ah 1000 won, waxay la mid tahay qiyaasta, sidaas darteed ma aha tusaale.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: 487+518=1005 waa ka weyn tahay 1000, 480+510=990 na waa ka yar tahay 1000. Xitaa marka qiyaasyadu isku mid yihiin, 1000, wadarrada dhabta ahi waxay noqon karaan labada dhinac ee heerka. Sidaas darteed marka qiyaastu le'eg tahay heerka, ha go'aamin adigoo qiyaasta oo keliya; si dhow u eeg.
